newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 3.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - South African Airways starts twice-weekly service between Johannesburg and Abidjan. - Growth is key to our development, an analysis of New Year message by Ivory Coast President Henri Konan Bedie. LA VOIE - Finance Minister N'Goran Niamien tells news briefing he is satisfied with Ivory Coast's plan to clear its internal debt arrears. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
